remediation_proposal.principle: neither side is authoritative enough to delete; both are recoverable evidence

4. Only for content that remains unrecoverable, record a tombstone row rather than deleting metadata, so lineage stays auditable.
5. Re-run the artifact verification and the backup script against the repaired pair.
